name: Veer Mikhailobna
original_name: ヴェール・ミハイロヴナ
source:
Born 02/11/2036
A 'Super Elite' boy who already graduated university with great grades.
He's kind, but he doesn't open his heart easily.
When he was younger his older brother died fighting in space.
